published.title: Separating compliance officer roles from controlling individuals put on hold
published.summary: The SRA has paused its proposed rules requiring firms to separate compliance officer roles from individuals with unilateral control. The rules will not start in January as originally planned.

published.title: Updates to the Statement of Solicitor Competence and FLK proposed
published.summary: The SRA is consulting on updates to the Statement of Solicitor Competence, which sets the competence standards expected of all solicitors throughout their careers, and to the SQE functioning legal knowledge.

published.title: High Risk Third Countries list updated after FATF plenary
published.summary: HM Treasury has updated its advisory notice on High Risk Third Countries under the Money Laundering Regulations. The update reflects changes to the FATF lists agreed at its October 2026 plenary.

published.title: Annual reporting of frozen assets held for designated persons
published.summary: Anyone holding or controlling funds or economic resources of a designated person must complete OFSI's frozen asset reporting form for the 2026 review by 30 November 2026.

published.title: New general licence for legal fees paid by designated persons
published.summary: OFSI has issued Legal Services General Licence INT/2026/11112108. It lets UK law firms and counsel be paid by a designated person for legal advice without a specific licence, if the licence terms are met.

updated.title: New general licence for legal fees paid by designated persons
updated.summary: OFSI has issued Legal Services General Licence INT/2026/11112108, which expires on 28 April 2027. It lets UK law firms and counsel be paid by a designated person for legal advice without a specific licence, if its terms are met.
updated.event: OFSI confirmed General Licence INT/2026/11112108 expires on 28 April 2027.
